starting-off.text: A cutscene starts right after freeing the last council member.

starting-off.speaker: Aris
starting-off.text: Now you've freed them all, I'll restart time so you can deal with the culinaromancer.
Aris casts a spell, restarting time and freeing the culinaromancer.

starting-off.speaker: Aris
starting-off.text: We have broken your feeble spell! Begone!

starting-off.speaker: Culinaromancer
starting-off.text: But you cannot defeat me! I'LL BE BACK!
The Culinaromancer teleports away, leaving a portal behind him.

starting-off.speaker: Aris
starting-off.text: One day he'll return. You must go through the portal and finish him off.

starting-off-talking-to-aris-again.speaker: Aris
starting-off-talking-to-aris-again.text: Adventurer, you must hurry! You have freed the members of the secret council, but we must ensure that the Culinaromancer is defeated once and for all!

starting-off-talking-to-aris-again.speaker: Aris
starting-off-talking-to-aris-again.text: Follow him into the portal and make sure he never leaves again!

starting-off-talking-to-the-cook.player: So... You don't happen to remember what I did after the Culinaromancer escaped into that magic portal thingy do you?

starting-off-talking-to-the-cook.speaker: Cook
starting-off-talking-to-the-cook.text: Of course I do! It was amazing!

starting-off-talking-to-the-cook.speaker: Cook
starting-off-talking-to-the-cook.text: You jumped in right behind him and fought him to the death!

starting-off-talking-to-the-cook.player: ...Oh yeah, that's right. And it was a really easy fight wasn't it...?

starting-off-talking-to-the-cook.speaker: Cook
starting-off-talking-to-the-cook.text: Oh no! You told me it was really hard, and that you had to defeat a string of monsters without any prayer!

starting-off-talking-to-the-cook.player: Oh. I did, did I? Oh.

facing-the-culinaromancer-entering-the-p.speaker: Aris
facing-the-culinaromancer-entering-the-p.text: [player name], I must warn you, inside that dimension you will have no assistance from the gods, and your prayers will not work at all!

facing-the-culinaromancer-entering-the-p.speaker: Aris
facing-the-culinaromancer-entering-the-p.text: Also be aware that he will use his powers to draw upon the might of foes you have fought before, and that dimensional instability means that your lost items will be irretrievable should you die...

facing-the-culinaromancer-entering-the-p.speaker: Aris
facing-the-culinaromancer-entering-the-p.text: Take care, I suspect the Culinaromancer will not give up so easily!

facing-the-culinaromancer-fighting-agrit.speaker: Culinaromancer
facing-the-culinaromancer-fighting-agrit.text: Say hello to my little friend!

facing-the-culinaromancer-fighting-flamb.speaker: Culinaromancer
facing-the-culinaromancer-fighting-flamb.text: I will not be thwarted by you!

facing-the-culinaromancer-fighting-karam.speaker: Culinaromancer
facing-the-culinaromancer-fighting-karam.text: You should not meddle in affairs that do not concern you!

facing-the-culinaromancer-fighting-karam.speaker: Culinaromancer
facing-the-culinaromancer-fighting-karam.text: I have waited a long time for my revenge!

facing-the-culinaromancer-fighting-desso.speaker: Culinaromancer
facing-the-culinaromancer-fighting-desso.text: Let's see how you deal with this!

facing-the-culinaromancer-fighting-the-g.speaker: Culinaromancer
facing-the-culinaromancer-fighting-the-g.text: I still have a few tricks left!

facing-the-culinaromancer-fighting-the-g.speaker: Culinaromancer
facing-the-culinaromancer-fighting-the-g.text: You've been lucky so far, but no more!

facing-the-culinaromancer-fighting-the-g.speaker: Culinaromancer
facing-the-culinaromancer-fighting-the-g.text: You have caused me enough grief! I guess I'll have to finish you off myself!

facing-the-culinaromancer-fighting-the-c.speaker: Culinaromancer
facing-the-culinaromancer-fighting-the-c.text: It seems I will have to deal with you myself!
His head and chest inflates before popping into a variety of desserts that go flying everywhere.

facing-the-culinaromancer-fighting-the-c.speaker: Aris
facing-the-culinaromancer-fighting-the-c.text: Good work [player name]! I think that will be the last we'll see of him! You'd better come back now.
